item.title: Text Categorization Using Encoder only Transformer
item.description:
Institution

National University of Sciences and Technology, Islamabad, Pakistan
Dec 2023 - Jan 2024

Project Description

The goal here was to sort text into a fixed set of categories automatically. I used an encoder-only transformer, the same family as BERT, because it builds a representation of the whole input, which suits classification well.

Project Highlights

  • Built a text categorization model on an encoder-only transformer architecture.
  • Evaluated and fine-tuned the model so it categorized a varied mix of text reliably.
  • Implemented everything in Python with Hugging Face Transformers and scikit-learn.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Python
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  • Transformers
  • Text Classification
  • Machine Learning

item.title: Sentiment Analysis Using BERT
item.description:
Institution

National University of Sciences and Technology, Islamabad, Pakistan
Oct 2023 - Dec 2023

Project Description

For this project I built a sentiment classifier using BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers). BERT reads each word in the context of the whole sentence, which matters a lot for sentiment, where a single word like “not” can flip the meaning.

Project Highlights

  • Fine-tuned pre-trained BERT models for sentiment classification instead of training from scratch.
  • Prepared the text data with standard NLP preprocessing before training.
  • Wrote the pipeline in Python using HuggingFace Transformers and TensorFlow.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Python
  • Natural Language Processing (NLP)
  • BERT
  • Machine Learning
  • Data Preprocessing

item.title: Car Price Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
item.description: In this project I helped build a machine learning model that predicts the price of a car from a wide range of its features.

item.title: Multiclass Image Classification using Transfer Learning
item.description:
Project Description

I built a multiclass image classifier on top of InceptionResNetV2. Rather than training a large network from scratch, I started from a pre-trained model and reused what it had already learned, then trained it to recognize my own set of classes.

Project Highlights

  • Used InceptionResNetV2 as the base model and adapted it to the target classes through transfer learning.
  • Added data augmentation and input normalization so the model would do better on images it had not seen during training.
  • Wrote the full training and evaluation pipeline in Python.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Python
  • Deep Learning
  • Transfer Learning
  • Computer Vision
  • Data Augmentation

item.title: Adaptive Irrigated Agriculture Monitoring (Embedded + Cloud)
item.description:
Project Description

This was an IoT system for keeping track of conditions in the field. Embedded sensor nodes measured soil and air conditions and sent the readings to the cloud in real time, so irrigation could follow what the crop actually needed instead of a fixed schedule.

Project Highlights

  • Built the embedded sensor setup that reads soil and air conditions.
  • Connected the sensor nodes to the cloud for real-time monitoring.
  • Used the incoming data to decide when and how much to irrigate.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • Embedded Systems
  • IoT
  • Sensors
  • Cloud Integration
